name: Spring Lock
hint: Two plates, three crates. Not every crate gets to keep its place.
catch: the gate needs a crate on BOTH plates, but the east plate can only be loaded by pushing north from the spring below it. A crate has to drown so you can stand there — and the one that can reach the spring is the one you parked on the south plate. Spend it, then refill that plate with the far-west crate. (Phase 1, K2: written first.)
